claim.claim-text: 1. A method comprising:

determining one or more values represented by the encoding units (600) embedded within the one or more symbols; and wherein determining whether the optically active article (108) is counterfeit based on whether the article message (126) and the combination of the validation information of the at least one security element (132) is valid comprises determining whether a combination of the one or more values represented by the encoding units (600) embedded within the one or more symbols and the validation information of the at least one security element (132) is valid.
2. The method of claim 1,

wherein the at least one security element (132) is included in a plurality of security elements (132), and wherein each of the plurality of security elements (132) is disposed at a different respective location of the optically active article (108).

3. The method of claim 2, wherein each of the plurality of security elements (132) being disposed at a different respective location of the optically active article (108) comprises each of the plurality of security elements (132) being disposed in an array at the optically active article (108).
4. The method of claim 1,

wherein the optically active article (108) comprises a plurality of security elements (132) disposed at a different respective locations of the optically active article (108), wherein a first security element that reflects the light above a threshold light intensity is active and a second security element which does not reflect the light above the threshold light intensity is inactive, and wherein determining the validation information is based on the first security element being active or the second security element being inactive.
5. The method of claim 1,

wherein the optically active article (108) comprises a plurality of security elements (132) disposed at a different respective locations of the optically active article (108), wherein a first security element that reflects the light above a threshold light intensity is inactive and a second security element which does not reflect the light above the threshold light intensity is active, and wherein determining the validation information is based on the first security element being active or the second security element being inactive.
6. The method of claim 1, wherein determining the validation information further comprises:

7. The method of claim 6, wherein determining, based on one or more pixel values in the predefined image regions (142), one or more values that represent the validation information further comprises determining one or more values that represent the validation information based on whether the one or more predefined image regions (142) of security elements (132) are active or inactive.

8. The method of claim 1, wherein determining the validation information further comprises determining the validation information based on at least one of a location, shape, size, pattern, composition of the at least one security element (132).
9. The method of claim 1, wherein performing the one or more operations further comprises:

determining that the optically active article (108) is counterfeit; and generating at least one of a notification or a reporting entry that indicates the optically active article (108) is counterfeit.

10. The method of claim 1, wherein determining whether the optically active article (108) is counterfeit, further comprises: determining, by the computing device (116), whether the validation information satisfies one or more rules of a validation configuration that was used to generate the construct the optically active article (108) with the article message (126) and the at least one security element (132), wherein the one or more rules of the validation configuration define a valid association between the article message (126) and the validation information of the one or more security elements (132).
11. The method of claim 1, wherein the at least one security element (132) is not embedded within any of the one or more symbols.
12. The method of claim 1, further comprising:

determining that a particular image region (142) of the image (109) represents one or more symbols of the article message (126); and wherein determining whether the optically active article (108) is counterfeit comprises determining whether a combination of the one or more symbols of the article message (126) and the validation information represent a valid association.
13. A system comprising:

an image capture device (102) that captures an image (109) of an optically active article (108) that is based on light captured outside a visible light spectrum, wherein the optically active article (108) includes at least one security element (132) and an article message (126); and a counterfeit article detection device communicatively coupled to the image capture device (102), the counterfeit article detection device comprising:

a communication component that receives, from the image capture device (102), the image (109) of the optically active article (108); a security component that determines validation information that is detectable outside the visible light spectrum from the at least one security element (132), wherein the security component determines whether the optically active article (108) is counterfeit based on whether a combination of the article message (126) and the validation information of the at least one security element (132) is valid; and a service component that performs, based on whether the optically active article (108) is counterfeit, one or more operations, wherein the article message (126) includes one or more encoding units (600) embedded within one or more symbols that comprise the article message (126), the method further comprising:

determining one or more values represented by the encoding units (600) embedded within the one or more symbols; and wherein determining whether the optically active article (108) is counterfeit based on whether the article message (126) and the combination of the validation information of the at least one security element (132) is valid comprises determining whether a combination of the one or more values represented by the encoding units (600) embedded within the one or more symbols and the validation information of the at least one security element (132) is valid.
14. The system of claim 13, wherein the optically active article (108) comprises
a retroreflective substrate; and the least one security element (132) and the article message (126) are disposed at the retroreflective substrate.
